tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Pico 2)
tasks.detail: Configures Pico 2 project inside the subfolder.

tasks.label: CMake: Build & Show %
tasks.command: cmake --build ./pico_sdk_sigrok/build ; $elf='./pico_sdk_sigrok/build/pico_sdk_sigrok.elf' ; if (Test-Path $elf) { $stats = arm-none-eabi-size $elf | Select-String -Pattern '\d+' ; $vals = [regex]::Matches($stats, '\d+') | % { [int]$_.Value } ; $f_pct = [math]::Round(($vals[0] / 16MB) * 100, 2) ; $r_pct = [math]::Round(($vals[1] / 520KB) * 100, 2) ; Write-Host '--- Usage Summary ---' -ForegroundColor Cyan ; Write-Host ('Flash: {0} bytes ({1}%) of 16MB' -f $vals[0], $f_pct) ; Write-Host ('SRAM:  {0} bytes ({1}%) of 520KB' -f $vals[1], $r_pct) }
